accounting_rule: For every task, provider-reported input_tokens plus output_tokens must not exceed 12000. Missing, malformed and over-budget runs remain in the denominator as failures.

phases.name: solve
phases.instruction: Produce one final structured solution, counterexample analysis and probe predictions.

phases.name: blind_proposals
phases.instruction: Each call independently proposes a final structured solution.

phases.name: selection
phases.instruction: Choose or reject one anonymized proposal without private oracle access.

phases.name: proposals
phases.instruction: Produce four independent proposals without fixed roles.

phases.name: open_critiques
phases.instruction: Each participant sees and critiques all proposals; authorship is visible.

phases.name: judge
phases.instruction: A model judge synthesizes one final answer.

phases.name: blind_commit
phases.instruction: Four agents use the same generic quality function.

phases.name: fracture_and_mutate
phases.instruction: Apply the RAZLOM-4 mutation protocol without incompatible role objectives.

phases.name: anonymous_guillotine
phases.instruction: Review non-self candidates; deterministic gates and maximin select the result.

phases.name: fracture_and_mutate
phases.instruction: Each fixed role attacks all three foreign proposals, discards one own assumption and creates or rejects one causal mutation.

phases.name: anonymous_guillotine
phases.instruction: Each role reviews exactly three foreign candidates; deterministic gates and maximin select the result.
